items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clifford was very close to him.

ctx.x: . . . he knew Clifford Brown. I don’t know how he wound up with the Chess people, but they immediately suggested that he make an album with the trio. We met him. He’s a very nice guy. He had known Clifford. Clifford was very close to him. So he said, “Do you mind if we make a tribute to Clifford Brown?” I said, “Of course not.” He’s a wonderful player, as you can tell.
